points: After the Mar 2017 MBIS/MWIS Code amendments allowing an RI to appoint a **Level 2 representative** in the supervision team (App. VI Table 1), IVE runs **top-up courses** for (i) **TCP T1** (building or minor works) with 2 years' relevant experience and (ii) **authorised signatories** of RGBC or RMWC (Class I, Type A or B). With **5 years'** experience plus the course, they may act as Level 2 representatives; the **RI keeps overall responsibility**.
配合 2017 年 3 月守則修訂（註冊檢驗人員可委任**第 2 級代表**），IVE 為 (i) 具 2 年經驗的 **T1 技術人員**及 (ii) 承建商**獲授權簽署人**開辦**銜接課程**；具 **5 年**經驗並完成課程者可擔任第 2 級代表，**註冊檢驗人員仍負全責**。

A building plan site may include only land the applicant owns or has a **realistic prospect of controlling**. The BA considers all information, e.g. (a) **percentage of ownership** acquired, (b) steps to acquire the rest, (c) steps to get other owners' consent for joint redevelopment.
地盤只可包括申請人擁有或**有實際機會控制**的土地；當局考慮 (a) 已取得業權百分比、(b) 收購其餘業權的行動、(c) 取得其他業主同意合併重建的行動。

points: **Minor works before demolition** (removing UBW, projections, windows; slab openings for debris; precautionary measures) – one-stop processing by **NBD1** if the same **project team** (AP, RSE, RSC (Demolition), RGE where applicable) does the demolition: submit **MW01 ≥ 7 days** before start **with the demolition plans** (showing the MW and TG protective measures; photos not needed if in the building appraisal report); submit **MW02** with **Form BA14A** (photos not needed if the whole building is demolished), or separately to NBD1 if completed before Form BA10. The RSC(D) must also be registered for the MW class/type, with the same AS.
**拆卸前小型工程**（清拆僭建物、伸出物、窗；開洞運送廢料；防護措施）：如由負責拆卸的同一**項目小組**進行，可由**新建築物科一組**一站式處理：**MW01 須於動工前 ≥ 7 日**隨拆卸圖則提交；**MW02** 隨 **BA14A** 提交；拆卸專門承建商須同時註冊相關小型工程類別。

Concrete Code amendments (Jun 2017): **"cementitious content"** (cement + silica fume + PFA or GGBS) replaces cement content; revised **minimum cementitious content** (Table 4.2); post-fire investigation of **spalling protection** in high strength concrete; **flange beam** longitudinal shear; shear in **circular columns**; beam-column joints; crack width for **0.1 mm** limits; alternative design of **exposed cantilevered slabs** by limiting steel stress.
混凝土守則修訂（2017 年 6 月）：以**膠凝材料含量**取代水泥含量；修訂最少含量；高強度混凝土火災後**剝落防護**檢查；翼樑縱向剪力；**圓柱**剪力；樑柱接頭；**0.1 毫米**裂縫；外露懸臂板替代設計。

Publication of the **Code of Practice for Foundations 2017** (review of the 2004 Code since 2012), usable at once. Major revisions: **bearing capacity equation** for shallow foundations and **plate load test** criteria; **settlement** estimation and acceptance; **Scheduled Areas 2 and 4** (marble); uplift, overturning and buoyancy with the **highest possible groundwater table** and overall stability; pile types; **re-use of foundations**; **monitoring plan**, vibration and settlement limits; **PR plan** for piling; more testing guidance.

points: BD audits often find non-compliance.
